steps.note: Inspect. The records in scope are listed, and any skipped file is reported.
Partition. The records are cut into chunks, each read on its own.
Map. Each chunk is checked against this skill's rules, one chunk at a time.
Order. A step waits for the steps it depends on. A dependency still in use blocks the chain.
Verify. Each cited line is re-read, and a finding that does not hold is dropped.
Report. Status: draft for the owner to review. It is not a decision.

outcome.verdict: 1 dependency is still in use, so do not retire yet

findings.title: Dependency still in use
findings.fix: Move the dependency before retiring the system

findings.title: Step with no record
findings.fix: Record the step and its date

outcome.notChecked: Whether the data was really deleted.

example:
Illustrative example: the items and results are made up, not real output.
Summary: 3 findings (1 high, 1 medium, 1 low).
[high] step-dependency-db.md:12  Dependency still in use.
       Fix: Move the dependency before retiring the system.
[medium] step-records.md:19  Step with no record.
       Fix: Record the step and its date.
[low] step-licences.md:26  Licence step with no owner.
       Fix: Assign an owner.
Not checked: Whether the data was really deleted.
pros: Flags a step with no owner, a step with no record, and a dependency still in use.
cons: Not checked: Whether the data was really deleted.
input: The records for this review, as text or CSV
output: A draft report: findings with location, fix and a not-checked list
prompt: Use the rlm-techops-decommission-checklist skill on the records for this review.
